snippet.title: HELLBOUND INC - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
OUT AUGUST 11TH

A rage-inducing precision platformer where you jump, carry, and deliver packages against time, demons, and HR. Play as an undead courier trapped in a fulfillment center recently acquired by Satan himself.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3746940/HELLBOUND_INC/
